technique_name: Describe a system that would help increase employee engagement.
description: A system that can help increase employee engagement should provide employees with incentives to stay engaged and empowered. Some potential components of such a system include regular feedback and meaningful rewards and recognition, flexible working hours, learning and development opportunities and career progression, a safe and supportive working environment, and opportunities for employees to give back to the community.
